question: In the context of a IBM Watson cognitive virtual agent, what type of input data can the IBM Watson Conversation service consume? A. images B. speech C. string of text D. audio

How can an IBM Watson Conversation agent be configured in a language other than English? A. The only language offered for Watson Conversation is English due to limitations in compatibility with other IBM Watson services that can be integrated in to a Watson Conversation agent. B. Use the available REST API to configure the language using the ISO country code. C. Upon creating a workspace for the Watson Conversation agent, select the language of the conversational agent in the Language drop-down. D. In the Conversation workspace, check the box next to the supported language within the panel in the Dialog tab.
